decision_rule.BLOCKED: At least one blocking gate is missing release-grade machine-readable execution evidence.
decision_rule.FAIL: At least one blocking gate has recorded failure evidence.
decision_rule.PASS: All blocking gates have recorded pass evidence and there are no advisory warnings.
decision_rule.WARNING: No blocking failures exist, but advisory warnings or missing advisory evidence remain.
